title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: A mixed‑quality matrix tape that captures a monster Smokestack Lightning and an adventurous Dark Star, with the board‑recorded second half sounding solid.
ai_review.review: The show shines thanks to a scorching 15‑minute Pigpen showcase on Smokestack Lightning and a wandering Dark Star that eventually settles into a strong groove before rolling into St. Stephen. Recording quality is uneven – low‑gen audience tape at the start improves dramatically after it switches to a clean board source, making the latter half very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the performance (especially Pigpen and Dark Star) while noting variable but improving recording quality, yielding an overall strong show with decent technical fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Starts as low‑generation audience tape, switches to a clean board source around Dark Star and stays solid thereafter; early sections sound muddy, later sections are clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opens explosively with Pigpen's Smokestack Lightning, drifts through a variable‑quality Dark Star that eventually finds its groove, and finishes the first half on a strong St. Stephen as the recording quality improves.

band_member_comments.Bob: One reviewer notes Bob Weir screaming during a sudden return to St. Stephen.
